_comment: The models llama-swap offers on Framework (docs/llama-swap/plan.md, phase 4). Installed to
llama-swap's config from this file and the builds on disk: one entry per model and backend, named
<id>-<backend>, plus <id>-<backend>-candidate while that backend has a candidate build different from current.
backends: the llama-builds backends that can load the model (fork, upstream, upstream-hip).
args: extra llama-server flags, after the common ones (port 8080, API key, --alias <entry id>, all layers on GPU).
Chat templates for GGUFs that lack one (Ollama copies) are in files/llama-swap/templates/ -> /etc/llama-builds/templates/.
default: the entry loaded at boot (llama-swap-preload.service).
Weights' size for llm-memgate is measured from the files when the config is written.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash UD-IQ2_XXS
models.note: glm5-next metadata rewrite; the fork has no glm5next arch.

models.name: Laguna-S-2.1 UD-Q4_K_M
models.note: Scored 75.5% BFCL on llama.cpp vs 92.75% on Ollama (2026-09); check tool calls before trusting it.

models.name: Gemma4-26B-A4B QAT Q4_0
models.note: Text-only copy of /storage/models/llm/Gemma4-26B-A4B-QAT-Q4_0.gguf (Ollama layout: vision tower in the same file, which llama.cpp refuses, and no chat template in the GGUF); same text weights. No image input. Chat template: llama.cpp's Gemma 4 one.
